Body.Content:
Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now expands inline protection to supported local AI agents, helping safeguard sensitive data across human-to-agent and agent-to-tool interactions. Organizations can apply DLP policies to prompts, files, and tool interactions to block policy-violating data movement at supported interaction points. These controls help prevent sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users’ behalf.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
